ios.desc:
Teleprompter allows video recording with magic scroll scripts & lyrics for speech, vlog, songs and presentation.

 ▶Teleprompter: Voice Scrolling, Video Record, Script Import, Endless Customisation

From the people behind Teleprompter Pro, one of the oldest and most popular Teleprompter Apps comes Magic Teleprompter. Redesigned from the ground up listening to all of our customer feedback along the way. It's the best Teleprompter we've ever built and we think you're going to love it.

All the features you have come to expect from a Teleprompter app.
Note, some premium features require an optional In App Purchase.


Elevate Your Presence:
Unlock your true potential with our Teleprompter App! Craft seamless speeches, captivating videos, and confident presentations. Whether you're a content creator, public speaker, educator, or business professional, we've got you covered.

Unlimited Scripts, Limitless Creativity:
Ditch the limitations and embrace boundless creativity. Our app offers you the power to store and manage an unlimited number of scripts – all at your fingertips. Say goodbye to juggling scripts and hello to seamless organisation.

Record Like a Pro:
Transform your videos into professional productions with our video recording feature. Read your script while recording, ensuring flawless delivery every time. Engage your audience effortlessly with your well-articulated content.

Import with Ease:
Efficiency at its finest – effortlessly import your existing scripts. Whether it's from emails, cloud storage, or text documents, our app simplifies the process, so you can focus on perfecting your delivery.

Magic Scrolling:
Experience the magic of our smart scrolling feature. No more fumbling with manual adjustments – the app adjusts scrolling speed to match your pace, ensuring a smooth and natural flow throughout your performance.

Mirror Mode for Eye Contact:
Connect with your audience like never before using our innovative Mirror Mode. Maintain eye contact while reading your script on your device. This groundbreaking feature revolutionises the way you engage and captivate your viewers.

No Monthly Payments, Ever:
We value your commitment, which is why we offer a one-time purchase that unlocks all features. No hidden fees, no subscription traps – just a straightforward, premium experience at an unbeatable value.
